themes.title: Right-Wing Mainstreaming and Power Consolidation Ahead of Key Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing political movements across Western nations are demonstrating growing electoral momentum and institutional normalization. In Sweden, the Sweden Democrats stand on the brink of entering government, while Reform UK secures record fundraising and the US MAGA movement consolidates its political apparatus ahead of upcoming elections.

themes.title: Populist Economic Relief Promises and Tax Cuts Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are increasingly leveraging direct financial promises and targeted tax relief to rally working-class voters facing inflation. Campaigns in both the US and Sweden are prioritizing consumer cost reductions and direct cash returns as central campaign planks.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Promising a direct $5,000 dividend check to citizens contingent on midterm victory.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pledging household tax cuts and price reductions on fuel, electricity, and food.

themes.title: Nationalist Pressures to Reshape Immigration Policies and Border Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures continue to push anti-immigration policy changes and rhetorical frames that emphasize national sovereignty and demographics. From proposals excluding non-legal residents from civic enumeration in the US to structural shifts away from open asylum models in Scandinavia, migration remains a core unifying theme.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposing the exclusion of non-legal residents from the census and using rhetoric framing immigration as degrading national prosperity.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Electoral rise driving a permanent shift away from historically open migration and asylum policies.
